process: one owned Python worker per condition/seed; per-series original scalar seed reset
resource_policy: Public serial entry: no production queue/resource guard/resume claim; existing scientific/thread settings preserved.
actual_failures: stop and preserve CUDA/OOM/allocation/nonfinite state or scores/metrics/checkpoint readback/IO/data identity/worker/concurrency failures
resume: valid artifact identity + checksum only; never overwrite valid results; no automatic failed-job retry
memory_bank: rebuilt in RAM for each fitted encoder; not required persisted
checkpoint: full best-restored state saved and CPU readback-checked before atomic COMPLETE
